lessons.title: Week 4 Part 1: Building Daily Stability & Safe Routines
lessons.content: In Week 4 of Back on Track Recovery & Stability, this lesson focuses on building daily stability & safe routines. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
